title: Bill review and payable preparation
outcome: Review the supplier bills the customer submits, validate their completeness and arithmetic, classify policy exceptions, prepare advisory payable recommendations, and deliver an evidence-backed review package approved by a person.

inputFormat.compatibility: Ledger-compatible: the field names and integer minor-unit amounts of Ledger's contacts (kind vendor), accounts and bills, plus currency, tax, document references and approval state. The customer supplies the bill set; get-it reads no accounting system and holds no accounting credentials.

required.note: the chart of accounts / expense categories the bill lines name
the review date: future-dated and overdue are judged against it

optional.note: bills already processed, for duplicate detection
a bill whose total exceeds this (home-currency minor units) needs a document reference

fields.amounts: integer minor units of the bill's currency (cents for USD); line amountMinor >= 1; taxMinor, subtotalMinor and totalMinor >= 0; no decimals, no floats
fields.dates: ISO calendar dates YYYY-MM-DD; dueDate on or after billDate

currency.foreign: a bill in any other ISO 4217 currency is classified foreign_currency_review, reported in its own currency, and always requires review
currency.conversion: none: get-it never converts currencies; payable totals are reported per currency

statusRule: each bill takes the first status in this order for which it has an exception; a bill with no exception is ready_for_payable_approval

exceptionTypes.test: a required field is missing or invalid, an amount is not an integer in range, a date is not a calendar date, or dueDate is before billDate
vendorId is not in the vendor list
a line's accountId is not in the account list
another bill in the set has the same vendor and bill number (trimmed, case-insensitive)
a prior bill has the same vendor and bill number
another bill in the set has the same vendor, currency and total, a bill date within 3 calendar days, and a different bill number
subtotalMinor is given and differs from the sum of line amounts
the bill's taxMinor is given and differs from the sum of line taxes
totalMinor differs from the sum of line amounts plus the sum of line taxes
currency differs from the home currency
a line names an inactive account
the vendor has paymentTermsDays and dueDate is not billDate plus those calendar days
status is approved, posted or void: the bill is not awaiting approval
a home-currency total over policy.documentRequiredOverMinor, or any foreign-currency bill, without a document reference

document_missing.ask: a receipt or invoice document reference

humanReview.packetApproval: every delivery requires one person's approval of the exact approval-packet digest, by an operator who did not request the review; agents, services and customers cannot approve; a re-run or correction produces a new packet that needs a new approval; an approval request expires after 7 days
humanReview.flaggedForReview: an exception requires review when the bill's total exceeds 50000 minor units in the home currency, when the bill is in a foreign currency, or when the exception is a suspected duplicate
humanReview.customerDecisions: suspected duplicates are decided by the customer (confirmed, rejected or acknowledged); a decision is recorded and never changes an accounting record

recommendations.rule: ready_for_payable_approval → approve_for_payment; rejected_malformed → reject_resubmit; every other status → hold
recommendations.advisory: a recommendation is advice to the customer's approver; get-it approves, posts and pays nothing
recommendations.priority: overdue when dueDate is before asOfDate; due_soon when dueDate is on or before the policy.dueSoonBusinessDays-th business day after asOfDate; otherwise scheduled

deliverables.content: for every bill: its input digest, every validation check with its outcome, and the reference records it was checked against
the contract, snapshot and output digests and the sha256 of every other file; the approval binds to its digest

acceptanceCriteria.test: every bill in the snapshot has exactly one result, and no result names a bill outside it
every result, exception, request, recommendation and document reference cites input digests present in the snapshot manifest
reviewing the snapshot again under this contract gives the delivered output exactly
each bill's status is the first status, in contract order, among its exceptions, and each exception agrees with a failed check
every recommendation is advisory and one of the contract's values, and every input record still matches its digest
every delivered file matches the sha256 listed in the approval packet
a person other than the requester approved the delivered approval packet's digest
the package was published no later than the turnaround deadline

calendar.businessDays: Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays (observed dates: a Saturday holiday is observed the Friday before, a Sunday holiday the Monday after), in the customer's time zone

service.turnaroundStarts: when the first complete bill set is recorded for the order
service.deadline: the end (23:59:59.999, customer time zone) of the Nth counted business day after the start date
service.customerBlocked: a business day on which the order is blocked pending customer input at any time does not count toward the turnaround
service.correction: within the window and before acceptance, the customer may request a correction; get-it re-reviews (corrected inputs or a corrected review) and delivers a new package, with a new approval, under the same acceptance criteria and at no extra charge for bills in the original set
service.acceptance: the customer accepts a delivery in full, or partially by naming the bills accepted

charging.delivered: on full acceptance, charged on the bills counted
charging.partial: charged only when the customer accepts the completed portion, by the same pricing on the number of bills accepted
charging.failedWork: platform failures and deliveries that fail an acceptance criterion are not charged; a failed run is re-run at no charge
charging.cancelled: not charged, unless the customer accepts a completed portion (charged as partial)

excludedActions: create, update, approve, post, pay, void or delete a bill or any accounting record
post or reverse a journal entry
send email or any message to vendors
read or write an accounting system, database or ERP
match purchase orders, quantities, unit prices or receipts of goods
